author: Hais
body:
• Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed): HitByADagger
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: Death threats
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server: First I dind't death threat anyone I got mad by a guy, cause this boy/girl placed ladders on my staircase. I honestly did not mean to death threat, I was just saying what I said because I was angry. I did not think that I would get banned, I think that it should have been a warn because I did not know this rule.


    P.S.
    First appeal ever.

replies.body:
Dagger,

Saying "I hope you get cancer" is not a death threat, therefore you will be appealed.

However, you will be receiving a warning for rudeness.

Regards,
Newcleus
